newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks close up on back of blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks close up on back of blue chips.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed higher on Tuesday on foreign buying of blue chips, brokers said.

The all share index closed 6.6 points up at 798.5 with price gains outnumbering declines by 31 to 18. Blue chips Development Finance rose five rupees to 290, Gain Elevators 2.75 to 36.25, John Keells Holdings 4.75 to 310.25, Sampath Bank 3.50 to 79.
"Foreign fund managers are interested in fundamentally sound counters, which can be expected to maintain earnings growth," said Manjula Kumarasinghe of brokerage Jardine Fleming HNB.
Turnover, led by foreign buying of 60,000 Development Finance shares, was 45.5 million rupees.
There was a net inflow of foreign funds with buying worth 21.2 million rupees and selling worth 1.5 million, brokers said.
"This time you may see the all share rise to about 820 points before the next correction," said a broker who declined to be identified.
The market began correcting last Thursday after the all share hit 806.2 points the day before.
